verdicts.reason: A has a sensible two-column structure: the can is on the left, and the headline, subhead and CTA are stacked down a right column with a clear hierarchy. But the logo has been demoted to a tiny mark crammed against the bottom edge under the button, and the can sits slightly high, leaving dead space in the lower left. B's full-width headline reads well, but the logo floats at an arbitrary spot in the middle right with no alignment. The can is jammed into the bottom-left corner almost touching the edge, and the oversized CTA competes with the headline, so the lower half looks scattered rather than composed.
